python_only_boundaries.arbitrary_comparison_protocols: User-defined equality/order side effects remain outside the fixed native scalar domain.
python_only_boundaries.dynamic_getitem: Python getattr accepts arbitrary dynamic keys; native fixed fields use direct accessors.
python_only_boundaries.dynamic_setitem: Python setattr can add fields and bypass validation; native setters preserve invariants.
python_only_boundaries.numeric_type_equality: Python accepts False/True and 0.0/1.0 as event types; native uses an enum.
python_only_boundaries.python_nan_time: Python accepts NaN because NaN < 0 is false; native rejects NaN for sortable events.
python_only_boundaries.unvalidated_python_id: Python does not validate event id; native VirtualEventId is non-negative size_t.
